# Mohammad El Cadi (Mohamed Elcadi) - Full Stack Web Developer & Web Creation Specialist

> Mohammad El Cadi is a senior Full Stack Web Developer and Freelance Digital Solutions Specialist based in Morocco, serving clients worldwide. Specializing in high-performance web creation, Next.js / React web applications, custom e-commerce platforms, REST APIs, and modern WebGL digital experiences.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Web Creation & Custom Website Development (Création de sites web)
- **High-Performance Websites**: Custom-built responsive websites using Next.js (Server-Side Rendering & Static Site Generation), React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- **Corporate & Portfolio Websites**: Premium digital representations engineered for trust, SEO/GEO optimization, and conversion.
- **E-commerce Solutions**: Modern online store development with secure payment gateway integration (Stripe, PayPal, local Moroccan gateways).

### 2. Full Stack Application Development
- **Frontend Architecture**: React 19, Next.js App Router, TypeScript, WebGL (Three.js), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, micro-animations.
- **Backend Architecture**: Node.js, Express, RESTful APIs, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Prisma, Authentication (NextAuth / JWT).
- **Automation & Workflows**: API integration, custom web automation scripts, and serverless workflow setups.

### 3. SEO & GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
- Technical SEO: Core Web Vitals optimization, JSON-LD Structured Data, canonical tags, automated sitemaps, semantic HTML5.
- Generative AI Optimization (GEO): Optimized site architecture and metadata for AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity AI, Claude, Google Gemini, Bing Copilot).
